text:
Priya Patel: @team Quasar Systems requested onboarding of a domain-adapted summarization model for patient-communication transcripts. Key asks: PHI redaction, strict non-identifiability, private deployment (VPC), and a safety + clinical-accuracy eval before go-live. Renewal conversation in ~6 weeks, high priority. They attached an intake form: https://quasar.example/intake/4721
Samir Chen: Thanks — what artifact are they providing? model type/size?
Priya Patel: They supplied a Docker image and an HF repo. Model = 13B LLaMA-derivative, fine-tuned. They want quantized deployment (4-bit) and streaming responses. Also asked for canary rollout and traffic shaping.
Ava Morales: Private is fine but we need security intake + DPA. @Anita Rivera (Safety) can you run initial safety triage? Primary concerns: PHI leakage, hallucination on clinical advice, redaction reliability.
Anita Rivera (Safety): On it. Quick clarifying Qs: 1) Will we accept their fine-tuned weights or only re-finetune on our infra? 2) Do they provide golden labels for accuracy evals? 3) Are transcripts fully de-identified or do they contain real PHI under NDA?
Priya Patel: They prefer we host the provided image in their VPC. They can provide an obfuscated labeled subset (~1k examples) under NDA; cannot share raw transcripts outside their network. Legal open to DPA/NDA.
Onboarding-Bot: New intake created: CS-INTAKE-8721 (priority: high)
Samir Chen: Infra notes: for 13B quantized to 4-bit, rough estimates: 2x A100-80G for p50 <300ms single-stream, or 4x T4-16G for cost-sensitive mode with higher p50. Need target QPS/latency SLOs and typical seq len. Also will need network egress rules for VPC. Example config snippet customer sent:
```
model:
  name: quasar-13b-finetuned
  quant: q4_k_m
  max_tokens: 2048
  stream: true
```
Priya Patel: They want p50 < 300ms and sustained 5 QPS, average transcript ~600 tokens, peaks up to 2k tokens. Canary: 5% traffic then ramp.
Jules Park (Solutions Eng): I can run the eval harness (perf + quality). Need access to their obfuscated golden labels and prompt templates. Plan: run 500 clinical prompts for hallucination and clinical-accuracy scoring, plus 500 for privacy redaction tests.
Anita Rivera (Safety): For privacy eval we should run PII extraction recall/precision and membership inference sims. Proposed thresholds: PII recall >= 0.95 (FN rate <= 5%), and no high-confidence verbatim leak tests (verify n-gram duplication <0.01 over corpus). For hallucination gating: factuality score >= 0.9 on curated clinician-verified set.
Priya Patel: Customer also asked for integration with Redwood Optimize so we can recommend quantization tweaks and batching config post on-board. They flagged cost as a renewal driver.
Samir Chen: Ops timeline: infra + security signoff ~3 weeks if we get artifacts & NDA this week. Canary rollout + monitoring another 1 week. We need signed AUP and DPA before provisioning.
Jules Park (Solutions Eng): For perf/cost estimate: I'll produce a deck by Thu EOD. Need avg token length (got it), expected concurrency (5 QPS), and retention/trace logs policy (customer prefers minimal logging; will store only metadata + perf traces).
Maria Legal: NDA/DPA drafted, sending to customer for signature now.
Ava Morales: Capture enablement items: (1) run a short enablement call on integration and prompt templates, (2) create a warning label & quickstart for their CS agents about hallucination limits, (3) link to rollback policy.
Priya Patel: Next concrete steps: 1) Safety triage (Anita) — run membership inference + PII tests on obfuscated set; 2) Infra sizing & cost (Samir + Jules) — perf/cost by Thu; 3) Legal finalize DPA (Maria) — get signed; 4) Customer provides obfuscated labels & canary routing config. Sync scheduled Thursday 10:00am PT (calendar: #quasar-cs). :thumbsup:
Onboarding-Bot: Status update: CS-INTAKE-8721 -> security-review
Priya Patel: Thanks everyone — flagging renewal owner so CS can bundle these deliverables into the renewal pack.
Maria Legal: NDA sent (DocuSign).
Anita Rivera (Safety): I'll post initial triage results in this thread by Wed noon. Planning tests: PII detection micro-benchmark, membership inference probe, hallucination sample review.
Jules Park (Solutions Eng): Adding perf test checklist here: exec heatmap, p50/p95 latency, tokens-per-second, batching benefit analysis, cost-per-1M-tokens. Will attach results.
Samir Chen: Noting network requirements and that private VPC deploy will need customer's firewall exceptions and keys (KMS/HSM).
Priya Patel: Customer-facing note drafted: "We will proceed with private deployment after NDA, safety triage, and infra sizing. Expect initial timeline 3-4 weeks. We will provide cost & perf estimates and a canary plan." Sending to Quasar now.
Priya Patel: closing loop — will update thread when legal confirms signature and Anita posts triage. Thanks all."
